## Quick Verdict

Plane and Linear are both free, unlimited‑member issue trackers, but they target different needs. Plane is open‑source, self‑hostable, and built for small‑to‑medium teams that want extensible workflows without licensing fees. Linear offers a streamlined, quick‑setup UI focused on simple issue tracking for small teams. Choose Plane for customization and self‑hosting; choose Linear for a polished, out‑of‑the‑box experience.

## Side-by-Side Comparison

| Feature | Plane | Linear |
|---|---|---|
| Category | Issue Tracking and Project Management | Issue Tracking and Project Management |
| Best Fit | small to medium teams needing a free, self‑hosted solution with extensible workflows | simple issue tracking for small teams that prefer a clean, ready‑to‑use UI |

## When to Choose Plane

- Plane is open‑source and free for unlimited members, eliminating licensing costs.
- Its simple interface makes onboarding easy for product managers and developers.
- The platform is extensible, allowing teams to craft custom workflows beyond basic issue tracking.

## Strengths of Plane

- Open-source and free for unlimited members
- Simple, easy-to-use interface
- Extensible for custom workflows
- No licensing costs

## Limitations of Plane

- File upload size limited to 5 MB
- Issue cap of 1,000 per instance
- Limited scalability for large enterprises

## Who Should Not Choose Plane

- organizations requiring large file uploads beyond 5 MB
- projects that need more than 1,000 issues

Check https://plane.so/ for current pricing.

## When to Choose Linear

- Linear provides a streamlined, easy‑to‑use interface that reduces setup time.
- It supports basic issue tracking with a focus on a clean user experience.
- The tool is free for unlimited members, making it suitable for small collaborative groups.

## Strengths of Linear

- free for unlimited members
- streamlined, easy-to-use interface
- quick setup without complex configuration
- supports basic issue tracking

## Limitations of Linear

- maximum 250 active issues
- file upload size limited to 10 MB
- unknown hosting options may limit enterprise use

## Who Should Not Choose Linear

- limited to 250 active issues
- file uploads capped at 10 MB
- no self-hosted or enterprise deployment options known

Check https://linear.app/ for current pricing.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### When is Plane better than Linear?
Plane shines when a team needs a self‑hosted, open‑source solution that can be customized without licensing fees. Its extensible workflow capabilities suit product managers and developers who want more control over their process.

### When is Linear better than Plane?
Linear is ideal for teams that prioritize a polished, out‑of‑the‑box UI and quick setup. Its streamlined design works well for simple issue tracking where extensive customization isn’t required.

### What are the main limitations of each tool?
Plane’s limitations include a cap on issue volume and file upload size, which can affect large‑scale projects. Linear’s constraints involve a lower active‑issue limit and limited hosting options, which may not meet enterprise deployment needs.
